nodes.rationale: All LibGit2Sharp calls serialized on one executor thread because Repository is not thread-safe; UI thread only awaits, never blocks.

nodes.label: GitService.Executor (GitExecutor)
nodes.rationale: Repository object is not thread-safe; a single dedicated thread serializes all libgit2/CLI calls.

nodes.label: RepositoryWatcher
nodes.rationale: FileSystemWatcher with 400 ms debounce, Refs vs WorkingDir classification; app ops wrapped in Suppress() scopes; 5-minute DispatcherTimer only as failsafe.

nodes.label: GitService.CreateCommit
nodes.rationale: LibGit2Sharp Repository.Commit auto-detects MERGE_HEAD and adds the second parent with the message verbatim.

nodes.label: MERGE_MSG Conflicts block
nodes.rationale: git merge --continue with GIT_EDITOR=true applies --cleanup=strip and drops the # Conflicts: block; the block survives in MERGE_MSG until commit, so it is read at Continue time.

nodes.label: Cancellation-token race

nodes.norm_label: bitbucket bearer auth via native credential helper

nodes.label: ConflictResultEditBox
nodes.rationale: AvalonEdit ignores WPF Typography attached properties; ligatures suppressed via custom TextRunTypographyProperties subclass and colorizer.

nodes.label: DiffView.ScrollDiffItemToTop
nodes.rationale: WPF ScrollIntoView scrolls minimum distance, landing hunks at bottom; compute offset from index x fixed row height, clamped to ScrollableHeight.

nodes.label: RepositoryViewModel.PrimaryRemote
nodes.rationale: Remotes.FirstOrDefault() picked a braid local-path remote without a credential helper, triggering a needless credentials dialog; prefer origin, else first.

nodes.label: VirtualizingStackPanel mis-positions variable-height rows
nodes.rationale: Hunk header row overlapped by the following row in custom-templated diff ListView.

nodes.label: Conflict transition forces Staged/Unstaged view
nodes.rationale: Forcing ShowWorkingDir on every tick during a conflict clobbered user navigation; only force on absent-to-present transition (second occurrence in RefreshConflictStateAsync).

nodes.label: Skip reselect when SHA unchanged
nodes.rationale: Reassigning SelectedNode after GraphNodes rebuild re-triggered LoadCommitDetail and cleared diff; second occurrence also found in ApplyFilter.

nodes.label: Run Mode
nodes.rationale: manual gates each step; auto runs consecutively but still stops on deviations, blockers, or human-only stubs.

nodes.label: Step Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Every stub verified GREEN and deviations approved before a step is marked done.

nodes.label: Feedback Loop First
nodes.rationale: A fast deterministic pass/fail signal makes bisection and hypothesis testing mechanical.
